title: shape: a person's words made into a requirement, and what code found changed
description:
Result of `speccoder shape`: the assistant's proposal for a field, and
what code found it changed — added and dropped words, sentences that
landed nowhere, values introduced without an assumption, and what makes
the text hard to test. Nothing is written anywhere.

field.description:
The field it is for: `requirement`, `feature`, `quick`,
`bug_symptom`, `bug_expected`, `bug_unchanged`, `answer` or `note`.

format.description: The spec format it is written for (`speckit`, `openspec`).

original.description: The person's words, as given (cut at 20 000 characters).

cut.description: The person's words were longer and were cut.

proposal.description: The proposal, as it would go into the field.

language.description: The person's language, when it is not the spec's.

back_translation.description:
The proposal translated back into the person's language (then the
diff and the coverage are against it).

diff.description: Which words are the person's, added or dropped (by code).

assumptions.description: Values the assistant says it introduced.

unexplained.description: Added numbers and terms no assumption explains (by code).

coverage.description: Where each of the person's sentences went (by code).

questions.description: Questions the assistant left open instead of guessing.

findings.description: The writing check of the proposal (model-free).

findings_before.description: The writing check of the person's own words.

run_id.description: The shaping run, when one ran.

Diff.description:
The proposal's stretches (yours or added) and the person's (yours or
dropped).

Span.description:
A stretch of text and its origin; the stretches of one text, in order,
are that text exactly.

Origin.description: Where a stretch of text came from.

oneOf.description: The person wrote it (in the proposal), or it was kept (in theirs).
The person wrote it and the proposal left it out.

Assumption.description: What the assistant says it introduced.

words.description: The proposal's words that carry it (`up to 10 000 rows`).

from.description: What the person wrote that it reads into, when anything (`fast`).

question.description: The question to ask instead of assuming it.

Coverage.description: Where one of the person's sentences went.

sentence.description: The sentence, as the person wrote it.

lines.description: The proposal's lines (0-based) that carry its words.

words.description: The words it is about (empty for the whole text).

reason.description: Why it makes the requirement hard to test, in a line.
